text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, after a training session, I'm
tidying up
the track before our time's
up.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...I'll be done in one more lap.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But a lap on this track is a relatively long

distance...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Don't worry. I always do this.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Disregarding my reply, Admire Vega
breaks into a
run. In that case...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, I continue to clean up. She
comes back
later, finishing her lap well
within our allotted
time.
choice_data_list: Let's start cleaning up little by little!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
You can go now. I'll take care of the
agility
ladder.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She must have a good reason. I watch as
she runs
off into the distance, then I
take my leave.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant... The stars... they're so pretty.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(It's so quiet... with no one to bother
me.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(This is how it should be... Since I have
to keep on
running... for her sake.)
